leftEvidence.title: The woman is built and brought to the man

points.label: Words about companionship
points.left: The man names animals but finds no matching helper; God builds the woman, brings her to him, and the source moves into kinship, one flesh, and unashamed nakedness.
points.right: Tobias and Sarah pray on their wedding night; the prayer recalls God making Adam, giving Eve as helper and support, and bringing human descendants from them.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Created, formed, and placed · core · Genesis 2:18–25
points.right: Adam in wisdom and reflection · later memory · Tobit 8:4–8

payload.posture: The woman is made, brought, and joined to the man as one flesh is held beside Adam and Eve are recalled as helper, support, and source of human descendants.

rightEvidence.title: Tobias remembers Adam and Eve while praying

payload.tension: Tobit recalls the first pair inside another couple’s prayer and uses helper language for its own request.
payload.title: The first marriage remembered in Tobit
